activity_context.topic_title: Identifying the Pivot Columns of a Matrix

feedback.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $C,$ given by

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -1 & 4 & -5 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 6 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $C$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -1 & 4 & -5 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 6 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(-\frac{1}{3}){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -1 & 4 & -5 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 6 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $C$ has $4$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $4.$
